notes.content:
Hello everyone! It is a pleasure to share with you!
We finally updated the new content to the game today!
Update the game now! Come and challenge the new leader!
[list]
[*] Add fifth level.
[*] Add 3 new animal character units.
[*] Add 5 enemy character units.
[*] Add two bosses and one hidden boss.
[*] Add 6 new skills.
[*] Add 4 events.
[*] Add 3 new achievements and 1 hidden achievement.
[*] Automatically slide to the next point in the map.
[*] Some skills have been changed. When there are multiple routes, the skills will be used according to the selected route.
[*] Game balance adjustment.

[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.2 update
notes.content:
1. Fix some bugs.
2. Some animal unit image adjustment.
3.Add keyboard auxiliary keys:
A, S, D, F, G correspond to the cards stored in battle.
Q, W, and E correspond to the discard cards in the storage cards in battle.
Z or UpArrow, DownArrow corresponds to fast switching when there are multiple routes in battle.
Space corresponds to the pause switch in battle.

notes.title: Roguelike and tower defense game Output Pasture available NOW
notes.content:
Developed by the duo team Dusk Dog Studio and released by HeartBeat Games, the Roguelike Tower Defense game "Output Pasture" will be officially launched on March 25, 2020. In this game, you can collect more than 100 different cute animals and skill cards, fight against the evil mechanical army that invades the Pasture, and discover more than 50 random events. The price of this game is US$8.99 with a 10% discount for the first week.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156900/_/

"Output Pasture" is a pixel art game combining Roguelike and Tower Defense gameplay. Players resist the invasion of the mechanical army by controlling the cute animals in the pasture. Simply use your mouse to select the fighting characters, you can have fun in the game. You can only win if you choose the right animals to play. Protecting the pasture is not that simple. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36152711/aee19801e4db834b3297cc0d2c1ee48c086bdb4d.png[/img]

"Output Pasture" offers a wealth of adorable creatures for players to collect: there are Corgis, Golden Retrievers and Huskies that dog lovers will love, and also cats with cannons for cat lovers. If you like large creatures, you will love bamboo-armed pandas, crocodiles with guitars, even the harmless and cuddly villain army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36152711/7b56f421e3b77c04262b3a3be5b3e78029f6cc39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36152711/2d8c6bc927003151f0c9424aea23129e5b3fc3ae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36152711/cd617917af45c1d87c883157063d63b35236b78a.png[/img]

In addition to these common animals, you can also find many creative fictional creatures in the game, such as you could never imagine what kind of creature the Gentleman is. Once you combine the golden retriever and husky, they will turn into a completely new destructive creature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36152711/e24189fcfd79718eb7e741e21abc165397a17aea.png[/img]

There are plenty of imaginative memes waiting to be explored in "Output Pasture": What is the Master Chief? What is a Rainbow Pony? What does Skeleton King look like? What other interesting memes can you find?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36152711/dc6a50f7ab6c05057cf52865c5b9fac061b8c16f.png[/img]

Beyond collecting cute and strange animals, you can't miss over 50 random events in "Output Pasture": what happens when you enter a creepy haunted house? What next if you are suddenly hijacked by an alien? Or what happens if you accidentally kick the vending machine? All these are in the game waiting for you to make a choice.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156900/_/

notes.title: Trial version 1.2 update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In this version, we have updated the unlock card mechanism,
When you have played the previous version and unlocked the card, you will be refunded the money you spent before upgrading to that version.

Another big mechanism update is the addition of a mechanism for storing cards using the middle mouse button during combat.
Make good use of this mechanism, I believe that you can easily cope with difficulties :)

Update:
1.Unlock card mechanism update
2.Game balance adjustment
3.Fix some known errors
4.Add temporary card mechanism

notes.title: Trial version 1.1 update
notes.content:
Thank you very much first of all!
After the trial version was launched, we received a lot of feedback from players,
Most people think that the game is not guided enough, and many functions cannot be clearly identified.
So this time I made some small changes to the game, I hope everyone will like it!
If you encounter any problems during the game, please tell us, thank you :)
